rationale: N-000384 specifies that AC blocks fold into a single verification atom; N-000807 states the general rule that blocks form exactly one node when a human id is adopted. The AC block claim is a specific application of the broader block-to-node rule.
quotes: A block labelled `AC-…` is folded by code into a single `verification` atom
only when the block forms exactly one node
